name: Tartaros University
card_quote: "I'm competitive but not at the highest level. I want to challenge myself and learn the game."
card_desc: University was made for players like you. A structured learning environment that still competes seriously. Pick up strategies from experienced players and build a proper understanding of CT.
modal_quote: "I'm competitive but not at the highest level. I want to challenge myself and learn the game."
modal_desc: University places more emphasis on player development than Academy does. If you want to properly understand CT — the meta, the strategy, how to score well — this is the team to be on. Experienced players are actively involved in helping newer members learn, and there's a genuine culture of knowledge-sharing here. Still competitive, still targeting top 100, just with learning at the centre of it.
requirements: Genuine interest in learning — that's the whole point of University
Participation each event — use your attacks and engage with CT
Receptive to guidance — willing to take on advice from more experienced players
Respectful attitude — everyone's at a different level, and patience matters
Active on Discord — most of the learning and planning happens there
